findings.evidence: Repository grep finds `natCard_quotient_under` and `AlgHom.IsArithFrobAt.sub_pow_mem` only inside this file, while `smul_sub_pow_mem` has no use beyond its declaration.
findings.fix: Make the first two private and remove or privatize the unused action wrapper; expose them later only when a concrete roadmap consumer needs them.
findings.issue: `natCard_quotient_under`, `AlgHom.IsArithFrobAt.sub_pow_mem`, and `IsArithFrobAt.smul_sub_pow_mem` expose proof plumbing beyond the requested square-root/Frobenius interface.

findings.evidence: The theorem rewrites `galoisGroupEquiv ... σ` directly to the canonical vector, while the parallel underlying evaluation rule `galoisGroupEquiv_apply` is already `@[simp]` at `Galois/Group.lean:247`.
findings.fix: Annotate it `@[simp]` so applications of the Galois-group equivalence to a proved Frobenius normalize to the Legendre vector.
findings.issue: `galoisGroupEquiv_frobenius`, the principal characteristic evaluation rule for the new API, lacks `@[simp]`.

summary: The roadmap-facing Frobenius API is present, but the PR unnecessarily exposes internal congruence machinery and omits the normal-form annotation on its principal evaluation theorem.
